name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Directed Seismic Control Array
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Directed Seismic Control Array
description: A system of deep-buried resonance generators that can create, dampen, or redirect seismic activity within a controlled area. The DSCA uses phased arrays of underground acoustic emitters to generate constructive or destructive interference patterns in geological strata, either amplifying natural seismic activity into damaging earthquakes or canceling incoming seismic waves to protect structures. Zheng-Dao developed the technology for earthquake defense but its offensive applications — the ability to cause earthquakes on demand — have obvious military implications.
enables: Seismic wave cancellation for structure protection
social_impact: The DSCA has given Zheng-Dao the ability to control earthquakes — to cause them, prevent them, or redirect them. This capability is a strategic deterrent comparable to nuclear weapons in its implications: the threat of seismic destruction can be used to coerce compliance without ever being deployed. GLMZ's population lives on ground that Zheng-Dao can, theoretically, shake apart at will.
story_hooks: A series of minor earthquakes in a Tier 2 district match the resonance signature of DSCA activity — someone is using seismic control to send a message or test the system's capabilities in an urban area.

A DSCA installation has been discovered to be counteracting natural seismic activity that would otherwise have caused a major earthquake — Zheng-Dao has been quietly preventing natural disasters and not telling anyone, building leverage for future negotiations.
